data.name: KungFu Dragon(泸龙)
data.detailed_description: A third-person historically grounded open-world action game set in the Republic of China era. Step into a waterside old town south of the Yangtze River under enemy occupation, and embody a righteous warrior hiding among common folk. Traverse stone-gate alleyways, canal docks, and the precarious fringes of foreign concessions. Engage enemies through versatile combat styles: close-quarters brawling, stealth assassinations, parry executions, alongside weaponry including the Eight-Cut Blade and staffs. Wipe out traitor collaborators, enemy spies and puppet lackeys with diverse gameplay loops. Carry out top-secret traitor-elimination missions amid the turbulent undercurrents of chaotic wartime, preserving the final integrity of this riverside city as an ordinary mortal. Full support for the Steam Workshop, enabling custom mod expansions covering bespoke levels, playable characters and weapon assets.

data.short_description: This is an open-world action game featuring a martial arts level progression system. Players can engage in unarmed combat or wield a wide variety of cold weapons for melee fights. Unique button combinations unleash distinct combo chains.
